description: Agent Handoffs: submit a handoff flow: each sender-to-receiver route with how the receiver confirms it has taken the task (an explicit acceptance, only a delivery receipt from the transport, or nothing), when the sender lets go (on acceptance or on send), how long the sender waits for acceptance and whether each acceptance is recorded, plus optionally the transfers made on those routes with when each was sent, accepted and released. The signed report names every route where the sender lets go on send or the receiver confirms nothing, every route that takes a delivery receipt for acceptance, has no acceptance window or keeps no record of acceptance, and every transfer let go with no acceptance, let go before its acceptance or accepted after its window, with the fix for each. This reads who holds a task between send and acceptance: what happens after a receiver refuses, fails or goes quiet is wever_handoff-failure-check, a delivered result against its order is wever_result-validation-check and a job’s work against its acceptance criteria is wever_deliverable-check. Verdict work_can_drop, acceptance_gaps, acceptance_unverified or held_until_accepted. POST /api/handoff-acceptance-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-handoffs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-handoffs/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

routes.description: Each sender-to-receiver route in the handoff flow.

acceptance.description: How the receiver confirms it has taken the task: an explicit acceptance, only a delivery receipt from the transport, or nothing.

acceptance_recorded.description: Each acceptance is written to a record the owner can read.

acceptance_window.description: How long the sender waits for acceptance before it acts, such as 5 minutes.

name.description: The route, such as planner to booker.

sender_releases.description: When the sender lets go of the task: on the receiver’s acceptance or as soon as it sends.

transfers.description: Handoffs made on these routes, with when each was sent, accepted and released.

released_at.description: When the sender let go of the task.

route.description: The route it took, by name.

name: wever_handoff-acceptance-check
title: Handoff acceptance check
